question: Can allocating the SAME 32 consequence interventions to actively distinguish pure semantic transformations from consistent unseen one-bit-GF2-shear challengers recover the familiar-world coverage lost in R1 without restoring unfamiliar-world confidently wrong predictions?
hypothesis: The R1 53% familiar coverage ceiling arose from query selection optimizing only the 720 pure permutations, not the 21,600 single-shear alternatives. Active interventions maximizing partition balance across the full 22,320 candidates will reduce ambiguity under exactly the same 32 source outcomes, restoring >=95% familiar coverage while retaining <=1% unfamiliar confident error and >=25% unfamiliar correct coverage.

source.warm: Exactly the same 64 learned public WSP130 origin laws, rewarm 128 paid source effects/law per arm, retain immutable original snapshots, never read origin hidden source masks in learner.
source.diagnostic: Already exposed WSP132 165000..165063 pure and 166000..166031 shear, development diagnostic only and NOT claim independent evaluation
source.new_prospective: New source-generated public synthetic condition seeds 169000..169063 pure; 170000..170031 shear, deterministic source-only sha256('WSP132R2|MAP|'+seed) shuffle of 720 permutation identity and 30 coordinate shears, no source labels to learner
source.transfer: 171000..171015 identity relabel of first16 169xxx learned transformed worlds, zero new actions
source.forbidden: WSP131 160xxx/161xxx and WSP132 165xxx/166xxx original result not changed; protected first-use and 172800..172863 unregistered source denied BEFORE RNG.

algorithm.hypotheses: 22,320 models = 720 pure permutation mappings + 720*30 mapping then one GF2 shear (coordinate i XOR=coordinate j), no true map/shear supplied; ignore duplicate *truth* models only in reporting, not candidate score.
algorithm.candidate_weights: Initially all 22,320 equal-weight packed bit IDs. For each public typed input x, precompute bitset of candidate predicted effects using immutable previously learned warm prior, direct model never reads hidden source. After each paid source effect, intersect candidate weights with positive-mask or its complement. Zero surviving => abstain.
algorithm.active_policy: For every unqueried x, calculate #remaining hypotheses predicting1 and predicting0. Choose maximum min(count1,count0), tie lowest x. If count<=1, fill remaining source budget using lowest unqueried x (still charge exactly32 outcomes). Never sample hidden evaluator or future source result.
algorithm.confidence: At withheld x confident prediction iff every surviving candidate agrees, otherwise ABSTAIN; on zero candidates ABSTAIN. Explicitly preserve 1% wrong cap and >=95% familiar correct held as independent gates.
algorithm.symbolic: Independently written exhaustive symbolic candidate enumeration and filtering, exact same active 32 action transcript. Result must be IDENTICAL to packed numeric on every held input.
algorithm.baseline: Original WSP131 pure 720 adaptive with its OWN 32 paid actions and identical budget; R1 passive enlarged-hypothesis confidence on old original action transcript receives same source effects as baseline. R2 full candidate active learner uses own 32 paid actions. Independent fixed 32 information-probe source-blind greedy optimized symbolic, same 32 effects different fixed transcript. Separate no-update and fully fitted CART receive R2 action consequences.

frozen_gates.positive: At least95% of14336 familiar held decisions correct, <=1% confident wrong, zero old warm knowledge changed and 4096/4096 correct on zero-source relabel transfer.
frozen_gates.negative: At most1% of7168 unfamiliar held confidently wrong, >=25% (1792/7168) useful correct predictions, at least 20/32 unfamiliar worlds return non-abstained correct predictions.
frozen_gates.controls: R2 numeric equals independently implemented exhaustive R2 symbolic decision-by-decision across both source conditions and zero-source transfer, matched 32 real actions per arm. R2 correct coverage not worse than strong fixed symbolic by >2pp on familiar. Fully fit CART and R1 passive challenger matched information reported; no unique numerical superiority when tie.
frozen_gates.cost: Track initialization amortization, per-world CPU, total wall time, tracemalloc peak, source calls, model capacity 22,320 hypotheses; strong symbolic source-to-score cost not assumed matched.
frozen_gates.success: DEVELOPMENT_R2_REPAIR_SUPPORTED_ON_PUBLIC_SYNTHETIC_ONLY if all positive negative transfer control gates pass, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
frozen_gates.partial: DEVELOPMENT_R2_REPAIR_PARTIAL if confident errors lower but familiar coverage or useful negative coverage fails.
frozen_gates.fail: DEVELOPMENT_R2_REPAIR_NO_GO for any primary failure or confidence regression; preserve source score and inspect rather than tune same cohort.
frozen_gates.invalid: Leakage, altered original source/cohorts, after-the-fact thresholds, privileged original first use, extra charged observations, missing exhaustive reference control, failure of mandatory dual-platform regression or G29.

custody.edit_budget: R2 is second of 3 distinct bounded repairs; R1 unmodified
